Brandon here, founder of DailyHelm.  
  
What is DailyHelm

DailyHelm is an agentic AI business reviewer for online businesses. It turns scattered analytics, ads, SEO, and store data into a prioritized daily action list.

Most founders waste time checking multiple dashboards and still miss revenue leaks. DailyHelm reviews your business overnight and tells you what needs attention today, ranked by revenue impact.

How it Works

@kate\_ramakaieva Thank you, Kate! You can start with just one. Each specialist agent only activates once you connect something it needs. Connect GA4 and you get analytics coverage from Iris; connect GitHub and you get Ada watching your deploys. More connections mean more cross-checking between agents (like linking a traffic drop to a bad deploy), but one connection is a legitimate way to start so give it a try, we have a 7-day free trial!
